title: DeepSeek 提出 Super-agent 架构设计：Router 与 Worker 双层架构，探索更自主的 Agent 系统
content: DeepSeek’s Harness team has introduced a Super-agent architecture designed to enhance engineering efficiency. Addressing the limitations of traditional single-session agents, this system employs a dual-layer structure with separate Router and Worker components, alongside event-driven mechanisms. The proposed design emphasizes continuous, efficient, proactive, and persistent characteristics. Experimental results indicate that this architecture surpasses traditional solutions in task completion efficiency and routing throughput. Although currently operational internally with a public prototype available, the team acknowledges that several technical challenges remain unresolved for this new autonomous agent system.

title: 刚刚，国行 Apple 智能官宣，但满血 SiriAI 还得等
content: Apple has officially announced the release of Apple Intelligence for mainland China, starting with iOS 27.3 developer tests in November and general availability in December. This initial rollout supports specific iPhone models and integrates Apple’s on-device foundation models with Alibaba’s Qwen for cloud-based capabilities like advanced writing and visual search. title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
content: Worldwide Express partnered with AWS to automate freight billing exceptions, which previously froze $15 million in cash flow monthly. Within six months, this solution reduced active exceptions by 75 percent, improved time-to-cash by four weeks, and saved over $1 million annually. The system processes 10,000 exceptions weekly with high accuracy, allowing the finance team to focus on complex disputes.
